pr_title: [Feature] DyntraLB: Dynamic Intra-decoder Data-parallel Load Balancing
source_quote: Please add patch descriptions and sunset plans to `https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py`

rule.description: 所有新增的 monkey-patch 必须在 `vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py` 中登记，包含 Why（为什么需要 patch）、How（如何 patch）、Related PR 和 Future Plan（何时移除 patch 的 sunset 计划）。
checkpoints: 新增 monkey-patch 时，检查是否在 `patch/__init__.py` 中添加了对应描述
描述是否包含 Why / How / Related PR / Future Plan 四个要素
后续 patch 编号是否顺延
Future Plan 是否明确说明 patch 何时可以移除

pattern.code:
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#   1. `vllm.model_executor.models.xxx`
#    Why: ...
#    How: ...
#    Related PR: ...
#    Future Plan: ...
#
# ** 4. File: platform/patch_xxx.py**
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#   ...
#
# ** 5. File: platform/patch_dyntra_lb_core.py**
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#   1. `vllm.v1.engine.core.EngineCoreProc.run_engine_core`
#      `vllm.v1.engine.core.DPEngineCoreProc`
#    Why:
#       PD-disaggregated decoder serving can develop uneven attention KV-cache
#       workloads across data-parallel ranks. Upstream vLLM does not currently
#       expose an extension point for selecting an Ascend-specific DP engine
#       core that coordinates dynamic cross-rank scheduling decisions.
#    How:
#       When DyntraLB is enabled, replace the DP engine-core process with the
#       DyntraLB implementation at engine startup. The patched class intercepts
#       the scheduling loop to perform cross-rank load exchange via Gloo
#       collectives before each scheduling step.
#    Related PR (if no, explain why):
#       https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12292
#    Future Plan:
#       Remove this patch after upstream vLLM provides stable scheduler and DP
#       engine-core plugin interfaces, or equivalent dynamic intra-decoder DP
#       load balancing that vllm-ascend can use without monkey-patching.
#
# ** 6. File: platform/patch_eplb.py**  # 编号顺延
# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
#   1. `vllm.xxx.yyy`
#    Why: ...
#    How: ...
#    Related PR: ...
#    Future Plan: ...
